```plato
    // The number of background-grid columns covering the region, or zero when the
    // radius is not positive — which is the empty answer rather than an error.
    PoissonColumns(region: Bounds2D, radius: Number): Integer
        => radius <= 0.0
            ? 0
            : ((region.Max.X - region.Min.X) / PoissonCellSize(radius)).Ceiling.ToInteger.Max(0);
```
